boolean_algebra.inputs: boolean only; domain state enum UNKNOWN is a separate typed literal, not helper UNAVAILABLE
boolean_algebra.output: boolean or UNAVAILABLE if required operand absent

collection_and_roster.inputs: Complete source-typed finite rows/multisets, nonempty exact natural-key field vector, expected tuple of matching arity and source types; duplicates preserved, full source cardinality/policy applies
collection_and_roster.output: boolean; missing proof input remains UNAVAILABLE

role_and_acl_views.inputs: Source-normalized SQL OID/name/role rows, object owner and exploded ACL rows (grantor/grantee/privilege/is_grantable); PUBLIC0 only in ACL domain; current-db implicit edges from exact Jsource normalization

native_tuples.inputs: Exact full frozen identity/context/frame/registry/work/credential/principal schemas; source/target, actual/approved, emitter/subject, SQL/native identity and pre/post state remain distinct; referenced digests bind complete source tuples

REQUIRED_TYPE.source_instantiation: Exact F per-case baseline view, mutation selector and full source schemas; no source identity chosen from equal-looking enum/field names
constraints: Caller full typed source normalization/authentication/cardinality remains an input acquisition gate
J ADMIN restricted to R!=A; outside-domain self-superuser divergence preserved

records.REQUIRED_CARDINALITY: One exact operand per scoped case; collection ports require complete source extent with duplicates preserved

DERIVATION_IF_ANY.INPUT_ESTABLISHMENT_SCOPE: Immutable literal definitions, exact source field schemas and symbolic constructor constraints; no measured values established
DERIVATION_IF_ANY.TRANSFORMATION: member=R.oid,target=A.oid from independent complete distinct R/A/M rows. ROLE_SOURCE_STATE carries full roles,memberships,databases and explicit DATABASE context as SET case, but exact source inserted R->M,M->A rows have inherit_option TRUE,set_option/admin_option FALSE. Every OID/grantor retained, rolinherit alone is not reachability; J builtin/owner-every-node semantics and exact current database proof preserved.
DERIVATION_IF_ANY.TYPE: Exact dict: roles full pg_roles rows, memberships full pg_auth_members rows, databases full pg_database rows, database_context DATABASE+source SQL oid
DERIVATION_IF_ANY.AUTHORITY: Frozen source/design rules and accepted pure local operator semantics only

role_and_acl_views.inputs: Source-normalized SQL OID/name/role rows, object owner and exploded ACL rows (grantor/grantee/privilege/is_grantable); PUBLIC0 only in ACL domain; current-db implicit edges from exact Jsource normalization

native_tuples.inputs: Exact full frozen identity/context/frame/registry/work/credential/principal schemas; source/target, actual/approved, emitter/subject, SQL/native identity and pre/post state remain distinct; referenced digests bind complete source tuples
